record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Hold not thy peace<WH02790><WTH8799>, O God<WH0430> of my praise<WH08416>;

For the mouth<WH06310> of the wicked<WH07563> and the mouth<WH06310> of the deceitful<WH04820> are opened<WH06605><WTH8804> against me: they have spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> against me with a lying<WH08267> tongue<WH03956>. <RF>of the deceitful: Heb. of deceit<Rf> <RF>are opened: Heb. have opened themselves<Rf>
They compassed<WH05437><WTH8804> me about also with words<WH01697> of hatred<WH08135>; and fought<WH03898><WTH8735> against me without a cause<WH02600>.
For my love<WH0160> they are my adversaries<WH07853><WTH8799>: but I <FI>give myself unto<Fi> prayer<WH08605>.
And they have rewarded<WH07760><WTH8799> me evil<WH07451> for good<WH02896>, and hatred<WH08135> for my love<WH0160>.<CM>
Set<WH06485><WTH8685> thou a wicked man<WH07563> over him: and let Satan<WH07854> stand<WH05975><WTH8799> at his right hand<WH03225>. <RF>Satan: or, an adversary<Rf>
When he shall be judged<WH08199><WTH8736>, let him be<WH03318><WTH8799> condemned<WH07563>: and let his prayer<WH08605> become sin<WH02401>. <RF>be condemned: Heb. go out guilty, or, wicked<Rf>
Let his days<WH03117> be few<WH04592>; <FI>and<Fi> let another<WH0312> take<WH03947><WTH8799> his office<WH06486>. <RF>office: or, charge<Rf>
Let his children<WH01121> be fatherless<WH03490>, and his wife<WH0802> a widow<WH0490>.

Let his children<WH01121> be continually<WH05128><WTH8800> vagabonds<WH05128><WTH8799>, and beg<WH07592><WTH8765>: let them seek<WH01875><WTH8804> <FI>their bread<Fi> also out of their desolate places<WH02723>.
Let the extortioner<WH05383><WTH8802> catch<WH05367><WTH8762> all that he hath; and let the strangers<WH02114><WTH8801> spoil<WH0962><WTH8799> his labour<WH03018>.
Let there be none to extend<WH04900><WTH8802> mercy<WH02617> unto him: neither let there be any to favour<WH02603><WTH8802> his fatherless children<WH03490>.
Let his posterity<WH0319> be cut off<WH03772><WTH8687>; <FI>and<Fi> in the generation<WH01755> following<WH0312> let their name<WH08034> be blotted out<WH04229><WTH8735>.
Let the iniquity<WH05771> of his fathers<WH01> be remembered<WH02142><WTH8735> with the LORD<WH03068>; and let not the sin<WH02403> of his mother<WH0517> be blotted out<WH04229><WTH8735>.
Let them be before the LORD<WH03068> continually<WH08548>, that he may cut off<WH03772><WTH8686> the memory<WH02143> of them from the earth<WH0776>.

Because that he remembered<WH02142><WTH8804> not to shew<WH06213><WTH8800> mercy<WH02617>, but persecuted<WH07291><WTH8799> the poor<WH06041> and needy<WH034> man<WH0376>, that he might even slay<WH04191><WTH8788> the broken<WH03512><WTH8737> in heart<WH03824>.
As he loved<WH0157><WTH8799> cursing<WH07045>, so let it come<WH0935><WTH8799> unto him: as he delighted<WH02654><WTH8804> not in blessing<WH01293>, so let it be far<WH07368><WTH8799> from him.

As he clothed<WH03847><WTH8799> himself with cursing<WH07045> like as with his garment<WH04055>, so let it come<WH0935><WTH8799> into his bowels<WH07130> like water<WH04325>, and like oil<WH08081> into his bones<WH06106>. <RF>into his bowels: Heb. within him<Rf>
Let it be unto him as the garment<WH0899> <FI>which<Fi> covereth<WH05844><WTH8799> him, and for a girdle<WH04206> wherewith he is girded<WH02296><WTH8799> continually<WH08548>.
<FI> Let<Fi> this <FI>be<Fi> the reward<WH06468> of mine adversaries<WH07853><WTH8802> from the LORD<WH03068>, and of them that speak<WH01696><WTH8802> evil<WH07451> against my soul<WH05315>.<CM>
But do<WH06213><WTH8798> thou for me, O GOD<WH03069> the Lord<WH0136>, for thy name's<WH08034> sake: because thy mercy<WH02617> <FI>is<Fi> good<WH02896>, deliver<WH05337><WTH8685> thou me.
For I <FI>am<Fi> poor<WH06041> and needy<WH034>, and my heart<WH03820> is wounded<WH02490><WTH8804> within<WH07130> me.
I am gone<WH01980><WTH8738> like the shadow<WH06738> when it declineth<WH05186><WTH8800>: I am tossed up and down<WH05287><WTH8738> as the locust<WH0697>.
My knees<WH01290> are weak<WH03782><WTH8804> through fasting<WH06685>; and my flesh<WH01320> faileth<WH03584><WTH8804> of fatness<WH08081>.
I became also a reproach<WH02781> unto them: <FI>when<Fi> they looked<WH07200><WTH8799> upon me they shaked<WH05128><WTH8686> their heads<WH07218>.
Help<WH05826><WTH8798> me, O LORD<WH03068> my God<WH0430>: O save<WH03467><WTH8685> me according to thy mercy<WH02617>:
That they may know<WH03045><WTH8799> that this <FI>is<Fi> thy hand<WH03027>; <FI>that<Fi> thou, LORD<WH03068>, hast done<WH06213><WTH8804> it.
Let them curse<WH07043><WTH8762>, but bless<WH01288><WTH8762> thou: when they arise<WH06965><WTH8804>, let them be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799>; but let thy servant<WH05650> rejoice<WH08055><WTH8799>.
Let mine adversaries<WH07853><WTH8802> be clothed<WH03847><WTH8799> with shame<WH03639>, and let them cover<WH05844><WTH8799> themselves with their own confusion<WH01322>, as with a mantle<WH04598>.
I will greatly<WH03966> praise<WH03034><WTH8686> the LORD<WH03068> with my mouth<WH06310>; yea, I will praise<WH01984><WTH8762> him among<WH08432> the multitude<WH07227>.

For he shall stand<WH05975><WTH8799> at the right hand<WH03225> of the poor<WH034>, to save<WH03467><WTH8687> <FI>him<Fi> from those that condemn<WH08199><WTH8802> his soul<WH05315>. <RF>those...: Heb. the judges of<Rf><CM>
